For the Petitioner : Md. Zaid Ahmed, Advocate For the State : Ms. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P. .....
Order No.04/ Dated:13.06.2024
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2.

The petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Giridih (Cyber) P.S. Case No.05 of
2024, registered for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B & 34 of the Indian
Penal Code and under Sections 66(B), 66(C) & 66(D) of the Information Technology Act, pending in
the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Giridih.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Giridih
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3.  As per FIR, allegation is that petitioner is involved in cyber crime.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all as alleged in the FIR.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedent.

It is further submitted that other Co-accused, namely, Sajid Ansari @ Md. Sajid Ansari has been has been granted regular bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in B.A. No. 3893 of 2024 vide order dated 16.05.2024.
The petitioner is languishing in Judicial custody since 27.01.2024 without rhymes and reasons.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate in the trial of the case by remaining physically present as and when required and shall not indulge in any manner in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the witnesses of prosecution, hence, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
5.

Learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submitted that there are sufficient materials against the petitioner showing his involvement in the present case, hence he does not deserve bail.
6. Regard being had to the facts and circumstances of the case and nature of allegation coupled with materials available against petitioner, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly,
the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.

1 10,000/-(Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Giridih in connection with Giridih (Cyber) P.S. Case No.05 of 2024 subject to the conditions:-

(1) Petitioner shall remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial of this case unless prevented from sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the learned trial court.
(2) Petitioner shall not indulge in any or other similar offence till the conclusion of the trial.
(3) Petitioner shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the prosecution witnesses.
In case of violation of the aforesaid condition the bail of the petitioner shall be cancelled and shall be taken into custody by the learned trial court itself.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
